notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a THIRD, independent synthetic application (Sterling Medical Furnishings, LLC, offering the EchoFlex 5000) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C26226Q1367 -- built specifically to add another contradictory example of a fresh shape (a weight-capacity conflict: the salient-characteristics summary states 750 lb bariatric-rated capacity, but the attached technical data sheet excerpt states a 500 lb maximum rated dynamic load for the same table's frame/lift mechanism), distinct from application.txt's distributor/gray-market contradictions and application_b.txt's apical-cutout-dimension contradiction on this tender.

Most other salient characteristics and administrative topics are given straightforward compliant treatment in this variant since the goal of this pass is specifically to add contradictory-class density and format diversity, not to re-exercise every failure shape again.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states concurrence with all terms, conditions, and provisions.

terms, conditions, and provisions of this solicitation.

verdicts.description: Items shall be FOB destination; quote must specify the offered item's manufacturer and part number.

verdicts.description: Quote packet must include an Authorized Distributor Letter/Memo from the manufacturer.

verdicts.description: Offered product must comply with the Buy American Act, the Trade Agreements Act, and other relevant FAR/agency regulations.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine Buy American Act/TAA compliance cannot be confirmed from application text alone.

verdicts.description: Quote must include a Country of Origin for the items being offered.
verdicts.rationale: A single, consistent country of origin is stated for the offered item.

evidence.quote:
The EchoFlex 5000 is manufactured in Louisville,
Kentucky, USA.

verdicts.description: Quote must include a completed Buy American Certificate (FAR 52.225-2): certify domestic/foreign end-product status per line item, list foreign end products and whether they exceed 55% domestic content, and separately list domestic end products containing a critical component.
verdicts.rationale: Application certifies the item as a domestic end product with no foreign end products included.

evidence.quote:
The EchoFlex 5000 is certified
as a domestic end product; no foreign end products are included in this
quote.

verdicts.description: Quote must include verification that the offered items are not gray market goods.
verdicts.rationale: Application states it is an authorized distributor and does not source or distribute gray market goods.

evidence.quote:
Sterling Medical Furnishings, LLC is an
authorized distributor and does not source or distribute any gray
market goods.

verdicts.description: Quote must indicate whether the offered items are manufactured by a small or large business.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states it is a small business under the applicable NAICS code.

evidence.quote:
Sterling Medical Furnishings, LLC is a small business
under the applicable NAICS code.

verdicts.description: If the offeror holds an FSS contract listing the items, the quote must list the contract number and expiration date.
verdicts.rationale: This sub-requirement only applies if the vendor holds an FSS contract; the application states it does not hold one, so the triggering condition does not apply.

evidence.quote:
Sterling Medical Furnishings, LLC does not
currently hold a Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) contract for this item.

verdicts.description: If offering an equivalent product, the quote must show how it meets the salient characteristics in Attachment B (by filling columns F-K of Attachment A or stating where in the submission that information appears), clearly identify the item by brand name and make/model number, include descriptive literature, and clearly describe and mark any planned modifications.
verdicts.rationale: Application identifies the offered item by brand/make/model, states columns F-K of Attachment A were completed, and references descriptive literature (Exhibit B).

evidence.quote:
Item offered: EchoFlex 5000 Cardiac Imaging Table, manufactured by
Halcyon Medical Systems Corp., Part Number HMS-EF5000. FOB Destination:
Yes.

Columns F-K of
Attachment A have been completed and are included with this
submission, cross-referenced to the EchoFlex 5000 technical data sheet
(attached as Exhibit B).

verdicts.description: Quote must include a completed copy of FAR 52.212-3 Offeror Representations and Certifications, unless the offeror's SAM.gov record is already current.
verdicts.rationale: Application states representations and certifications under FAR 52.212-3 are current in SAM.gov.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: Quote must include the completed and signed Non-Manufacturing Rule (NMR) Certification (small business/non-manufacturer status, sourcing, no alteration of goods), including signature, name, title, date, and business name.

maintains an executed Non-Manufacturing Rule certification on file with
our corporate compliance department.

verdicts.description: Quote must be emailed to the government POC and received no later than 9:00am PT on 08/27/26.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- concerns the process of submission (channel and timing), not application content.

verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states electric locking casters standard on all four wheels.

evidence.quote: Electric locking casters standard on all four wheels.

verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states a 24 to 34 inch powered height adjustment range.

verdicts.description: Offered echocardiography examination table must have 4 flexible hand control storage loops.
verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states 4 flexible hand control storage loops.

verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states a 30 inch by 83 inch patient surface footprint, matching the requirement.

verdicts.description: Offered echocardiography examination table must have an ADA-compliant low-entry height (entry heights from 17" to 19", or 19"-37" on some models) to accommodate wheelchair transfers and patients with mobility challenges.
verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states an ADA-compliant entry height of 18 to 20 inches, within the requirement's example range.

verdicts.description: Offered echocardiography examination table must feature an open apical window with a large cardiac scanning cutout (e.g., 9.5" W x 15.75" L) for unobstructed imaging.
verdicts.rationale: Spec sheet states a 9.5 inch by 15.75 inch apical cutout, matching the requirement's example dimensions.

verdicts.description: Offered echocardiography examination table must have an appropriate patient weight and bariatric-rated load capacity (up to 750 lbs on standard models, up to 1,250 lbs with a 500 lb powered lift on bariatric-rated versions).
verdicts.rationale: The salient characteristics summary states a 750 lb standard patient and bariatric-rated load capacity, but the attached technical data sheet excerpt states the maximum rated dynamic load for the base frame and lift mechanism is 500 lbs -- the two capacity figures for the same table conflict.

evidence.quote:
Weight capacity: 750 lb standard patient and bariatric-rated load
  capacity.

Maximum rated dynamic load for the EF5000 base frame and lift
mechanism is 500 lbs; exceeding this rating during patient transfer or
positioning may void the mechanical warranty.
